items.title: Mildred Major and Emma Zeno Interview, 1969-03-28
items.q: I used to manage him. I remember Nick. Well, he was with my father then at that time.

ctx.x: I must have been around 18 years old. About 18. And you sang at the concert? Yeah. Mr. Nick, I don't know if you remember his manager. I used to manage him. I remember Nick.
